name: clipboard_to_active
description: Paste the current clipboard contents into whichever application is currently focused.
prompt: Paste whatever is on the clipboard into the currently focused window. Flow: first verify the focused window, if 'before_paste' is non-empty type that text first, then press Ctrl+V to paste the clipboard contents. Do NOT modify the clipboard. Do NOT send, save, or close anything — just paste and stop. Optional preamble text: {{before_paste}}.
